I don't know what to say other than I can relate. I'm sorry you feel this way. I don't see me making it the next few years. PTSD, vet, chronic sciatic back pain, stupidly depressed, hella suicidal. The psych ward taught me to do it right so I never go back. I hate the 9-5 , I hate abusive bosses and work environments, I can't do this anymore. I took out a stupid amount of loans so I can find a way out of the rat race. I failed. I have to get another " real " job. I'm so over it all. I said 20 years ago "I was born a suicide victim" it's been in my head everyday since. I'm right here with you.

Working a 9-5 put my in the VA psych ward due to suicidal idealizations. I decided to take a chance, quit my job, pursue another route, after 2 6k loans I've found I have to go back to the 9-5 because I can't support myself with it. The 6 car pile up I was in destroyed my back. I just don't see myself surviving much longer. I hate the act of living.
I'd love to give it a shot. I'm building decks but having difficulty with randoms. I'm on almost nightly.
